# Skills.sh — The Agent Skills Directory
# Source: https://skills.sh
# Retrieved: 2026-08-30T00:00:00Z

## Overview

Skills.sh is the open agent skills ecosystem. Skills are reusable capabilities for AI agents.

## Installation

```
npx skills add <owner/repo>
```

Install specific skills:
```
npx skills add <owner/repo> --skill <name> -a <agent> -y
```

List available skills:
```
npx skills add <owner/repo> --list
```

## Supported agents

Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Gemini, Cline, AMP, Droid, Goose, Kilo, Kiro CLI, OpenCode, Roo, Trae, VS Code, Zed, and more.

## Registry format

skills.sh.json at repo root for skill grouping.
